summary: Compare components, methods, element specs, project formulas, and state machines before or after changes.
routingHints: Prefer object-specific diff commands when the component kind is known.
Use method-level diff for narrow code comparisons instead of whole-component diff.
Use state_machine_domain diff when semantic state-machine changes matter more than raw component snapshots.
Do not pair diff with AscetVerifyTool by default; only add post-write readback when confirming a live write outcome.
